title: Install Agent Designer if it is missing
summary: The Agent Designer is included in the 27.4 monthly update and automatically installs in upgraded sandboxes but not production environments. When copying a post-v27.4 production environment to a sandbox, you can manually install the Agent Designer using a specific AppSource URL with its app ID.
key_points: Agent Designer is part of the v27.4 monthly update and auto-installs in upgraded sandboxes
Production environments do not automatically receive the Agent Designer
Sandboxes copied from pre-v27.4 production environments need to be upgraded to v27.4 to get the Agent Designer
Sandboxes copied from post-v27.4 production environments do not auto-receive the Agent Designer but can be manually installed via AppSource URL
The Agent Designer app ID is 00155c68-8cdd-4d60-a451-2034ad094223

quotes.text: The Agent Designer is part of the 27.4 monthly update.
